title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 31: Saul and his sons die on Mount Gilboa, and the men of Jabesh Gilead bury them.

questions.text: Where did the men of Israel fall slain before the Philistines?
questions.explanation: The men of Israel fled from before the Philistines and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

answers.text: On Mount Carmel
In the valley of Elah
On Mount Gilboa
At Aphek

questions.text: Which sons of Saul did the Philistines kill?
questions.explanation: The Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

answers.text: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua
Jonathan, Abner, and Doeg
Abinadab, Eliab, and Shammah
Malchishua, Joab, and Asahel

questions.text: Who overtook Saul and greatly distressed him?
questions.explanation: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

answers.text: The chariots
The giants of Gath
David's men
The archers

questions.text: What did Saul ask his armor bearer to do?
questions.explanation: Saul said, "Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it," but his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified.

answers.text: Carry him off the battlefield
Draw his sword and thrust him through
Bring him water from the spring
Go and call for David

questions.text: What did the armor bearer do when he saw that Saul was dead?
questions.explanation: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died with him.

answers.text: He fled to the Philistines
He took Saul's crown to David
He hid Saul's body in a cave
He fell on his sword and died with him

questions.text: What did the men of Israel on the other side of the valley and beyond the Jordan do?
questions.explanation: They abandoned the cities and fled, and the Philistines came and lived in them.

answers.text: They gathered to fight the Philistines
They abandoned their cities and fled
They made Jonathan's son king
They sent tribute to the Philistines

questions.text: What did the Philistines do to Saul when they came to strip the slain?
questions.explanation: When the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul fallen on Mount Gilboa; they cut off his head and stripped off his armor.

answers.text: They buried him on the mountain
They gave his body to his family
They cut off his head and stripped off his armor
They burned his body on the battlefield

questions.text: Where did the Philistines put Saul's armor?
questions.explanation: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

answers.text: In the house of the Ashtaroth
In the temple of Dagon
In the palace of Achish
In the tent of their captain

questions.text: Who took the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan?
questions.explanation: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard it, all the valiant men went all night and took the bodies from the wall of Beth Shan.

answers.text: The valiant men of Jabesh Gilead
David and the men with him
The priests of the city of Nob
The elders of Bethlehem in Judah

questions.text: Where were the bones of Saul and his sons buried?
questions.explanation: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

answers.text: In the tomb of Kish in Gibeah
On the top of Mount Gilboa
In a cave near Ziklag
Under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh
